Display a strategic plan. If id is provided, show that plan; otherwise list
strategic_plan and show the first (e.g. STRAT-PLAN-001).

Respects field-level read permissions (BLI-642). Output format via --format.


  Show primary strategic plan
  zqk object splan show
  Show plan by ID
  zqk object splan show STRAT-PLAN-001
  Show in JSON format
  zqk object splan show --format json

Usage:
  zqk object splan show [id] [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
